dismantler.create_productionline.hint: Left = intermediate/finished, Right = Line Scheme; press [Dismantle] to restore materials and make a mirror (a recipe yielding N per craft needs N items inserted together)
item.create_productionline.generic_inter: A blob of intermediate product — before the final step, nobody knows what it is.
dismantler.create_productionline.done: Dismantled: reverted to raw materials, and a Line Scheme Mirror was placed in the slot.
dismantler.create_productionline.empty: Put an intermediate/finished item, and a Line Scheme in the right slot.
loader.create_productionline.inactive: Waiting: insert written Line Schemes to activate their recipes
loader.create_productionline.no_recipes: This scheme is a build guide only (no embedded Create recipe; nothing to activate)
item.create_productionline.line_scheme.r: Embedded Create recipes: %s (insert into a Scheme Loader to activate)
cpl.create_productionline.feed: Feed (Mechanical Arm / Funnel / Chute / drop-in — any)
item.create_productionline.guide.base: Base: %s (goes on the line first; other materials are fed onto the line by any feeder)
item.create_productionline.guide.howto: Build (assembly / Sequenced Assembly): put the base on a belt/depot -> place a Deployer above the belt (aimed at it) for each material, fed by a funnel/arm -> the base passes each Deployer in order -> pull the finished product off the end with a funnel/belt (if a Generic Intermediate comes out at the end, the sequence isn't finished / material is missing).
item.create_productionline.guide.deploye: Note: the Deployer executes the sequence steps (placing each material onto the base/intermediate in order); feed it by funnel / Mechanical Arm / drop-in.
item.create_productionline.guide.count: If the recipe yields more than it consumes (e.g. x2), split it with a funnel/tunnel into "one output + one reinvested into the line" for a net-positive, cultivation-style loop.
item.create_productionline.line_scheme.e: Empty. Compute a plan in the Production Computer.
screen.create_productionline.computer.em: Usage: left slot = item to produce; middle/right slots = paper / clipboard / blank Line Scheme. Press [Compute] when all are set.
screen.create_productionline.computer.no: This recipe cannot be converted into a Create line (e.g. the target is already produced by a native Create process, or the recipe has no usable materials). Nothing was written; your carriers are untouched.
screen.create_productionline.computer.ge: Generated native Create recipe JSON — written into the Line Scheme item; insert it into a Scheme Loader to activate!
screen.create_productionline.computer.no: Missing carrier: put paper, a clipboard or a blank Line Scheme in the middle or right slot, then press [Compute].
